caption: The video showcases a field of cut gemstones—round brilliants, ovals, marquise and pear shapes—suspended against a pure black void, denser along the left and right edges with a sparser middle. Throughout the excerpt the stones translate steadily downward, so those near the top edge glide toward the center while those at the bottom drift out of frame and fresh stones enter from above. Individual gems rotate and tumble as they descend, shifting their internal facet highlights and overall brightness, and a few stones in the center-left cluster fade toward near-black before brightening again as they turn. Star-shaped glints pulse on and off across several round brilliants, changing intensity between frames. A large central-bottom stone grows noticeably in apparent size as it descends, and several other stones likewise enlarge over the sequence, so this scaling is not confined to a single gem. Slight changes in relative spacing hint at mild depth differences. The rigid outlines of each gem remain undeformed throughout.
